title: Track receipt on invoice per purchase order line
summary: Receipt on invoice tracking can now be configured at the purchase order line level instead of just header level, with vendor-level defaults that cascade to new purchase lines.
key_points: Adds receipt on invoice control per purchase order line via new field in Purchase Line
Introduces vendor-level receipt on invoice default setting in Vendor table
Purchase lines inherit receipt on invoice from header or vendor configuration
Column is hidden by default under personalization in Purchase Order page
Includes upgrade logic to migrate existing header-level settings
